description:
A unique trail that connects Horsefly Lake to Quesnel Lake, therefore the trail heads are boat access only.
Trail traverses through some remnant old growth Cedar Valley before it exits out to Quesnel Lake. Hikers should be aware a short section of the trail has been impacted by fire, caution should be used while in the area during wind events.
directions: Boat Access only, on Horsefly Lake follow the North Shore of the lake and tuck in behind the large island at the entrance to Suey Bay. Along beach there is a creek outlet, trail head is by creek. On Quesnel Lake follow the South shorline up the East Arm of the lake. Across the lake from Peninula Bay is Slate Bay, trail head is tucked into the Eastern Edge of the Bay.
title: Suey/Slate Bay Trail
